label: early-middle original input of t/c/y/g/q
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, never at the delimiter or during copying, and never at t=0 or t=1. Activity peaks at t=3-5 and is nearly gone by t>=7. It is input-token selective: t is strongest (rate 26%), then c, y, g, q, with weaker contributions from o, a, x, w. Most activations are first occurrences of the token. The largest activations are on t at positions 3-4 when the prefix contains m/h/z/l/e/v, so earlier tokens shift the level up or down; this context effect is diffuse and could not be captured as a clean predicate. Weak activations spread over many other input tokens. The predicate (t, c, y, g or q at original steps 2-6) gets roughly 0.58 precision and recall, with about 0.72 mass recall on dev.
